reply.summary: Serense is a ruthless state operative who hunts the owner of a crashed starship and binds captives in glowing shackles that drain their strength. It relies on borrowed authority and patient cruelty rather than any gift of its own.

feats.scene: Serense slams a restraint cuff onto a struggling captive hard enough to bruise the bone.
Serense is flung into a steel wall by a desperate prisoner and gets up still giving orders.

reply.summary: Aulonane rebuilt her face and name to take revenge on a rubbery trickster who left her behind, then dropped the plan when she learned why he stayed away. She fights with trained hands and sharp detective instincts, and later shared his adventures.

feats.scene: Aulonane drops a charging gunman with a flurry of tight, practised strikes.
Aulonane crashes through a shop window during a chase and keeps running.

reply.summary: Ereleo is a bitter veteran-turned-bomber who torches targets with a fuel-gel launcher and plots to flood a metropolis with poison fumes. His grievance is real, his methods are monstrous, and his followers are few.

feats.scene: Ereleo sprays burning gel across a warehouse until the whole roof collapses in flames.
Ereleo takes a heavy beating from masked pursuers and is hauled off still breathing.

reply.summary: Amcoium is a mute government weapon whose veins run with poison that would kill anyone else. It obeys orders through a tracker under the skin and shrugs off wounds that would stop a crowd.

feats.scene: Amcoium hurls a fugitive across a motel room with one silent swing.
Amcoium walks calmly out of a flipped, burning truck with no sign of pain.

reply.summary: Tinlunt abandoned peaceful protest decades ago and now conjures phantom battalions and shellfire from every era to fight for him. He ages slowly, reads minds, and treats killing as a tidy trade.

feats.scene: Tinlunt calls down a phantom artillery barrage that flattens a whole row of warehouses.
Tinlunt shrugs off a glancing bullet graze and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Iateraus is a cold, white-haired intelligence officer who oversees contact with invaders across several decades. He will gladly kill a child to protect a secret, and the consequences echo through time.

feats.scene: Iateraus fires a single pistol round that ends a young boy's life in a quiet wood.
Iateraus is clubbed unconscious by escaping prisoners and wakes the next morning.

reply.summary: Corson is a cheerful errand runner who crossed an ocean as a child and now hauls parcels for a corner shop. He tags along on the adventures of a neighbourhood masked champion, always a step behind the danger.

feats.scene: Corson shoves a crate of bottles off a counter to block a thug's path.
Corson tumbles down a flight of stairs with a basket of deliveries and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Lleser was a temple priest whose cruelty cost a strongman everything. The strongman's rage ended the priest's life, and the memory of it still burns across the centuries.

feats.scene: Lleser strikes a kneeling servant with a ceremonial staff.
Lleser is seized by the throat and thrown down the temple steps by a furious avenger.

reply.summary: Taeor is a luminous being born of an idea, descending in primeval times to seed a world with the notion of costumed champions. Nothing forged by mortals could kill it, though a humble thinking object finally did.

feats.scene: Taeor floods the entire planet with a single idea, rewriting what its people dare to dream.
Taeor outlasts every blade, blast, and age of siege without a scratch.

reply.summary: Rininlu is a studious young artist raised in a closed country, unaware that his father is a sea monarch of scale and fire. Arrest by officials shoves him toward a destiny he never asked for.

feats.scene: Rininlu smashes through a locked interrogation door in a surge of newfound strength.
Rininlu weathers a squad's truncheon blows without breaking a rib.

reply.summary: Cantost is a half-divine sorcerer of a drowned age, trained from boyhood to shield his people from a coming catastrophe. He wears enchanted robes woven for his future and leads the champions of harmony against chaos.

feats.scene: Cantost hurls a spell that cracks a mountain pass and seals an invading horde beneath it.
Cantost stands in the heart of a collapsing tower of crystal and walks out unharmed.

reply.summary: Cilanuial is a long-dead sorcerer-king who rose again with colder eyes and a wider vision. Once a tender hero of the deep, it now wields vast arcane and scientific knowledge without a trace of pity.

feats.scene: Cilanuial calls a wall of sea and sorcery down upon a coastal metropolis.
Cilanuial rises from his own tomb unmarked by centuries of rot.

reply.summary: Amsir is a veiled cosmic guardian who once poured every ounce of her power into another to stop a world-eating invader. She loves a being of pure time and fate, and rival schemers have snared them both.

feats.scene: Amsir pours her whole essence into an ally and the surge scatters an invading armada across the void.
Amsir is bound by twelve relics of boundless might and survives the squeeze of an entire reality.

reply.summary: Rates is a purple-skinned officer of a stellar police force who died giving birth while her ring chose a successor. She kept her grim humour even as she lay dying.

feats.scene: Rates blasts a hulking raider back through a bulkhead with a glowing construct.
Rates is caught in a massive blast of shrapnel and clings to life long enough to speak.

reply.summary: Nauna is a golden-eyed deity of light who rules an ancient pantheon and appears at will in a flash of brilliance. A jealous twin once tore out his radiant heart, and a loyal lover fought to restore it.

feats.scene: Nauna bursts into a blinding flare that scorches a desert valley to glass.
Nauna lives on after his heart is ripped out, held together by his own radiance.

reply.summary: Enullueo is the greedy heir of a notorious umbrella-wielding crime lord, schooled in street brawling and nothing else. Its ambitions outrun its patience, and it ends up another victim of the family trade.

feats.scene: Enullueo pummels a rival courier into a gutter with a pair of heavy punches.
Enullueo takes a rooftop fall onto a parked van and staggers to his feet.

reply.summary: Riacin grew up in the mountains of her homeland, fought as a child soldier, and now works as an intelligence agent allied with a squad of outcasts. She prefers stealth and firearms to speeches.

feats.scene: Riacin fires a rifle round from a ridge and drops a target at long range.
Riacin rolls out of a moving vehicle and slips away into the brush.

reply.summary: Iummia is a reformed convict turned scientist who fights crime beside a masked mentor inside a bottled city. He was once framed by his own accomplices and later wed the niece of a mentor.

feats.scene: Iummia hurls a boosted punch that caves in a storage vault door.
Iummia shrugs off a collapsing lab ceiling and keeps working on the controls.

reply.summary: Ossereor is a soldier of a doomed world, husband and father, who charges a sealed city perimeter alongside his unit. He falls to a hostile machine before his daughter's eyes.

feats.scene: Ossereor drives a rifle butt into a drone's sensor array as his squad advances.
Ossereor absorbs a glancing scorch from an attacking probe before the fatal blow lands.

reply.summary: Oretan is a gentle child of a bright sky-realm who befriends a furious outsider after a schoolyard scrap. His family is slaughtered by raiders, and the grief reshapes a friend's whole life.

feats.scene: Oretan trades fierce blows with a young rival in the courtyard until both collapse laughing.
Oretan takes a thrown boulder to the chest and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Sersa is a scholar-warrior who redesigned a champion's armor by merging engineering with enchantment. She fought bravely once, then gave the suit away, convinced someone else carried it better.

feats.scene: Sersa slams a gauntleted fist through a barricade of crates to cover a retreat.
Sersa is struck by a bomb blast in her enchanted armor and survives with bruises.

reply.summary: Soriullo is an undying desert king who plots to wipe out modern humanity and resurrect his old realm through radio-controlled thralls. His servants live only while his will endures.

feats.scene: Soriullo cleaves a stone idol in half with one sweep of his blade.
Soriullo is buried under a collapsing pyramid chamber and walks out dusty and furious.

reply.summary: Neovaosa is a poacher-turned-tyrant who rules riverside villages with armed men and a reputation for the supernatural. He moves with blinding speed, fights with razor claws, and coats his wounds with venom.

feats.scene: Neovaosa rakes a heroine's shoulder open with a flurry of claws.
Neovaosa takes a hard strike to the jaw and sneers through the blood.
Neovaosa blurs across a village square before the onlookers can blink.

reply.summary: Ntiasi is a weary short-order cook whose restaurants keep getting wrecked by one brutish regular. He rebuilds each time, hoping the next grand opening will finally survive.

feats.scene: Ntiasi swings a frying pan at a would-be robber and clangs him across the skull.
Ntiasi is hauled around by thugs as a hostage and walks away shaken but whole.

reply.summary: Reoauser is a swaggering gangland chief who frightens witnesses into taking the fall for him. Only a lawyer's stubborn conscience stands in the way.

feats.scene: Reoauser orders a pistol fired at a trembling informant across a back-room table.
Reoauser shrugs off a thrown ashtray and calls for another round.

reply.summary: Viveori is a bloated crime chief who commands the underworld through loyalty and menace. A crusading attorney turned vigilante eventually targets his empire.

feats.scene: Viveori backhands a debtor across a restaurant booth, splintering the table.
Viveori takes a fall down a loading ramp and laughs about it.

reply.summary: Reorer is a gleeful young swindler who learns pranks from an older rogue, then overtakes him in daring heists. A jealous master and an angry hero both end up behind bars because of it.

feats.scene: Reorer springs a rigged trap that slams a vault door onto a guard's cart.
Reorer is flung through a hay cart by a stronger hero and bounces up cackling.

reply.summary: Seovaan is a century-old officer in a galactic peacekeeping force, armed with a glowing ring that builds objects from willpower. He is young for his people, cunning in a fight, and loyal to a family of partners.

feats.scene: Seovaan hammers a giant glowing construct into a rogue freighter and splits its hull in two.
Seovaan weathers a cannon salvo behind his ring's emerald barrier.

reply.summary: Searser is a quick-fingered street thief of a fabled desert city who stumbles into a wish-granting lamp. Time travelers pass through and he helps them.

feats.scene: Searser tosses a ripe melon that cracks a guard's helmet.
Searser tumbles off a market awning onto cobblestones and is up before the guard arrives.

reply.summary: Nansiacor is a daring flier and wartime adventurer famous for smashing enemy plots, who later retired under a new alias. He pilots submersible craft and fights hand to hand with practised precision.

feats.scene: Nansiacor knocks a saboteur off a dock with a thundering right hook.
Nansiacor crash-lands a fighter plane in a field and climbs out with a grin.

reply.summary: Tineas is a flashy filmmaker who doubled as his own stuntman after meeting a tough drifter. He hopes to cast the stranger again and throws lavish parties to impress him.

feats.scene: Tineas leaps from a prop truck and tackles a runaway camera dolly.
Tineas takes a staged car crash on set without a scratch.

reply.summary: Reveo is a retired local who opened a roadside restaurant themed on atomic-age nostalgia and passed it to his son. Whether he vanished or simply left the town is a mystery.

feats.scene: Reveo flips a heavy griddle with one practised heave.
Reveo slips on a greasy floor tile and bounces up laughing.

reply.summary: Llotelol is a secret wartime agent who lights the way for a team of masked operatives with a ring that conjures solid light. A traitor erases the hand wearing it.

feats.scene: Llotelol shapes a glowing wall of light that drives back a squad of armed guards.
Llotelol loses a hand to a vaporising blast and stays conscious long enough to report.

reply.summary: Ternuva draws power from a captive star-fragment and becomes a luminous guardian who befriends distant peacekeepers. It conjures solid light, shields allies, and soars on emerald beams.

feats.scene: Ternuva molds a colossal glowing fist that levels a whole block of warehouses.
Ternuva rides out a shockwave behind a shell of light that holds without a crack.

reply.summary: Stsor is a broadcasting magnate who once fought as a masked hero and later retires, afraid of his own power. He testifies before suspicious lawmakers while a hidden enemy waits.

feats.scene: Stsor remembers unleashing a blast he believes outweighs the bombs that ended the war.
Stsor is shot by a thief in an alley while unarmored and nearly dies.

reply.summary: Certel is a jailed roboticist whose attempt to build a perfect thinking machine ended in failure and a life sentence. He only wants his teacher daughter left in peace.

feats.scene: Certel shoves a toolbox across the cell at a visiting student.
Certel takes a hard fall down the prison stairs and shrugs it off.

reply.summary: Llluium is a nineteenth-century patriarch who founded a vast business empire and feared a secret society. He slips into a sewer while fleeing and meets a silent killer.

feats.scene: Llluium swings a cane at a masked attacker in the dark.
Llluium drops through an open manhole and keeps running on a bruised leg.

reply.summary: Laorive is a gray-haired preacher chosen for a cultural exchange with an island of warrior women. He is astonished by how they have lived without men for three thousand years.

feats.scene: Laorive swings a heavy hymnal at a startled sentry.
Laorive stumbles down a harbour ramp in his black coat and brushes himself off.

reply.summary: Resntar is a young scientist-in-training on a distant jungle world, fascinated by teleport beams and her father's theories. She guides visitors through the forest and develops a crush on an earthling.

feats.scene: Resntar triggers a ground charge that blasts a vine barrier out of a jungle path.
Resntar tumbles down a mossy slope and laughs while picking vines from her hair.

reply.summary: Liaunta is a half-human, half-alien anthropology student who gets teleported to a prison ship during a dig. She marries an explorer and helps defeat a captor.

feats.scene: Liaunta slams a lab stool into a guard drone during a jailbreak.
Liaunta is battered by a transport surge and stays standing.

reply.summary: Eosorium is a grieving traveler from a future world who builds a plague meant to turn every human into something alien. A time scientist hurls him into the distant past, where the virus escapes anyway.

feats.scene: Eosorium smashes a vault console to steal passage into the past.
Eosorium is hurled across centuries by a time device and lands alive.

reply.summary: Telcorniu is a red-haired warrior raised from childhood to fight an interdimensional tyrant, wearing a living liquid-metal suit forged by ancient sorcerers. The suit grants her flight, strength, and speed, and she sends the demon fleeing.

feats.scene: Telcorniu drives her blade through a demonic knot of flesh so hard that a ridge splits.
Telcorniu stands against a demon's crushing blow with her suit rippling around her.
Telcorniu rockets over a battlefield too fast for the eye.

reply.summary: Stitone is a corporate saboteur who dons a bird-themed disguise to wreck a rival railway. A masked hero and a determined reporter thwart the scheme.

feats.scene: Stitone pries a rail spike loose with a crowbar and sends a handcar tumbling.
Stitone is tackled onto a platform by a hero and wriggles in the grip.

reply.summary: Tileoceo was a college football star so brutal that opponents forfeited. Abducted by a secret program, he now fights as an armored warrior in a virtual world, shrugging off blows.

feats.scene: Tileoceo drives a shoulder into a barricade and bursts it into the street.
Tileoceo stands in the path of a speeding truck and the truck folds around him.

reply.summary: Raaun was a bullied, tiny student who trained under a retired boxer and became a ferocious bare-fisted crusader. An accident later made him far stronger.

feats.scene: Raaun lands a haymaker that launches a thug through a plank fence.
Raaun takes a brutal beating from a gang of enforcers and rises again.

reply.summary: Vatelna inherited atomic powers from a villainous grandfather and grows to towering size when he fights. He bounces between hero teams and a prison task force, and dreams of justice.

feats.scene: Vatelna swells to the height of a house and hurls a truck through a warehouse wall.
Vatelna stands in his enlarged form as a cannon salvo bursts across his chest.

reply.summary: Ritornti is a size-changing champion who battles a gigantic rival amid a wrecked metropolis. He grows enormous, hits hard, and takes giant blows without flinching.

feats.scene: Ritornti grows to the height of a tower and bats a giantess back through a billboard.
Ritornti stands firm as a giant fist lands on his shoulder.
